name: VL E-Governance & IT Solutions Limited
summary: VL E-Governance & IT Solutions Limited, headquartered in Mumbai and founded in 2016, delivers system integration and IT-enabled services for India's e-governance initiatives. Its two segments are E-Governance and IT/ITES, and the Vakrangee Kendra business, which manages a network of physical retail outlets called Nextgen Vakrangee Kendras.
